review: Independent final semantic-fidelity review of the integrated v1.25 clarity proposals
scope: All 55 complete old/new paragraph pairs, corresponding Current_Paragraphs context, and all 19 source/code/data resolution records were read. The final 55 pairs comprise the original 54 plus the root's Malay-abstract amendment. Primary-source excerpts and relevant local code were checked for the definitions at greatest risk of changing meaning. This is a bounded fidelity review, not certification of complete original-source coverage, a new literature search, a new security experiment, or an independent reproduction.
